visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A top-down shot reveals six smartphones arranged on a matte white surface. The devices display a variety of pastel and dark colors: lavender, powder blue, sage green, off-white, and charcoal black. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows beneath the phones. No people are visible in this initial overhead arrangement. (2) A young man with short black hair appears in a studio setting characterized by vertical metallic and orange-tinted slats. He wears a crisp white collared shirt and a narrow striped scarf. He holds a vibrant orange phone with a triple-lens camera module, posing for a mirror-style selfie before transitioning to a phone-call posture at his ear and then a horizontal photography stance. (3) The scene cuts to the same man, now layered with a brown checkered hoodie over his white shirt. He holds a silver smartphone with a white back panel. He maintains a serious facial expression while demonstrating the device's aesthetics through standard mirror selfie and ear-side positions against the same slatted architectural background. (4) The character changes outfits again into a blue-grey denim jacket. He holds a deep navy blue smartphone, showcasing its rear matte finish to the camera. His movements are deliberate and rhythmic, matching the visual tempo of the edit. He gazes into the lens with a neutral yet engaged facial expression. (5) Wearing the white shirt again, the man holds three phones simultaneously in his left hand while showcasing a light blue model in his right hand. He brings the light blue phone to his ear, looking upwards with a pensive expression, highlighting the device's profile against the bright studio lighting. (6) He shifts focus to a lavender-colored phone, holding it centrally in the frame. The camera is at a medium close-up shot size. He rotates the device slightly to show how the light hits the metallic edges and the glass back. (7) He displays a sage green phone, bringing it to his left ear while looking towards the upper right corner of the frame. He wears dark blue denim jeans. His posture is relaxed, and his facial expression is calm. (8) The character showcases a different model of smartphone featuring a single large circular lens on a white back. He holds it high for a selfie-style shot. He wears a white henley-style shirt with buttons at the neck. (9) Finally, he holds a gold-tinted version of the single-lens smartphone to his ear. He looks slightly down and away from the camera, showcasing the side profile and the metallic sheen of the device's frame.
